strings.new_session_menu: More ways to start a session
strings.quick_launch_editor_not_initialized: Quick launch editor is not initialized.
strings.quick_launch_error_payload_missing: Quick launch error payload is missing.
strings.process_terminated: Process was terminated. Press any key to close.
strings.empty_description: Open a terminal on this computer or run one of your launches.
strings.modes_no_other_modes: No other modes yet. Kubernetes and agent work will appear here.
strings.docker_not_installed_title: Docker or Podman is not installed
strings.docker_not_installed_text: Docker mode shows the containers, images, volumes and networks of a Docker or Podman engine on this computer. Install one of them, then check again.
strings.docker_stopped_title: Docker is installed but not running
strings.docker_stopped_text: The docker command is here, but nothing answers on its socket. Start the Docker service, then check again.
strings.docker_stopped_hint: On macOS, open Docker Desktop instead.
strings.docker_podman_off_title: Podman is installed but its API service is off
strings.docker_podman_off_text: OTTY talks to Podman through its API socket, which is off by default. Turn it on for your user, then check again.
strings.docker_podman_off_hint: On macOS, run podman machine start instead.
strings.docker_no_access_title: OTTY has no access to the Docker socket
strings.tpl_docker_no_access_text: {socket} belongs to the docker group, and your user is not in it.
strings.docker_no_access_label: Add your user to the docker group
strings.docker_no_access_hint: Log out and back in afterwards. Members of the docker group have root-level access to this computer.
strings.docker_panel_not_installed: No engine found on this computer.
strings.docker_panel_podman_off: The Podman API service is off.
strings.docker_panel_no_access: No access to the Docker socket.
strings.tpl_docker_looked_for: OTTY looked for {places}, and for docker and podman on PATH and in the usual install folders.
strings.docker_looked_for_commands: OTTY looked for docker and podman on PATH and in the usual install folders.
strings.docker_image_dangling: Dangling: no tag and no container uses it
strings.docker_shell_needs_docker: Shell needs the docker command. Install Docker, then check again.
strings.docker_shell_needs_podman: Shell needs the podman command. Install Podman, then check again.
strings.docker_remove_container_text: The container and the changes made inside it are deleted. Named volumes stay.
strings.tpl_docker_prune_containers_text: Stopped containers to delete: {count}. The changes made inside them are lost; named volumes stay.
strings.docker_remove_image_text: The image is deleted from this computer. You can pull it again later.
strings.docker_force_remove_image: Force: a stopped container still uses it
strings.tpl_docker_prune_images_text: Dangling images to delete: {count}. They have no tag and no container uses them.
strings.docker_remove_volume_text: The volume and all data in it are deleted. This cannot be undone.
strings.tpl_docker_prune_volumes_text: Volumes no container uses: {count}. They and all data in them are deleted, named ones too. This cannot be undone.
strings.tpl_docker_prune_anonymous_volumes_text: Anonymous volumes no container uses: {count}. They and all data in them are deleted. Named volumes stay. This cannot be undone.
strings.docker_remove_network_text: Containers can no longer join it.
strings.tpl_docker_prune_networks_text: Networks no container uses: {count}. Built-in networks stay.
strings.tpl_docker_volume_in_use_hint: Remove the container {names} first; the engine keeps volumes that are in use.
strings.docker_built_in_network_hint: The engine creates this network itself; it cannot be removed.
strings.docker_network_in_use_hint: Stop or remove the connected containers first.
strings.docker_logs_hint: Last 500 lines, new lines appear as they come.
strings.docker_run_subtitle: Starts a new container in the background. If it needs a terminal, open it with Shell afterwards.
strings.docker_run_pull_missing: Pull the image if it is missing
strings.docker_run_command_hint: Leave empty to run the image's own command.
strings.tpl_docker_run_command_hint: Leave empty to run the image's own command: {command}
strings.docker_run_volume_source: Volume or folder on this computer
strings.docker_run_relabel: Let the container read this folder (:z)
strings.docker_run_relabel_hint: Changes the SELinux labels of the folder's files.
strings.docker_restart_hint_on_failure: Starts again when it exits with an error.
strings.docker_restart_hint_unless_stopped: Comes back after a crash or a reboot, until you stop it.
strings.docker_restart_hint_always: Comes back after a crash or a reboot, even after you stopped it.
strings.docker_restart_hint_auto_remove: A container that is removed when it stops cannot restart.
strings.docker_run_auto_remove: Remove the container when it stops
strings.docker_run_err_image: Type an image, for example nginx:1.27.
strings.docker_run_err_port: A port is a number from 1 to 65535.
strings.docker_run_err_container_path: The path in the container must start with /, for example /cache.
strings.docker_run_err_source_required: Type a volume name or a folder on this computer.
strings.docker_run_err_source_missing: This folder is not on this computer.
strings.docker_run_fix_fields: Fix the marked fields to run.
strings.docker_run_panel_hint: What the image sets on its own. The form overrides it.
strings.docker_run_image_pulled_first: Not on this computer yet; it is pulled first.
strings.docker_run_image_not_pulled: Not on this computer yet. Turn on the pull switch, or the run fails.
strings.docker_run_no_image: Type an image to see what it sets on its own.
strings.palette_toggle_left_panel: Show or hide the left panel
strings.wizard_subtitle: Saved launches open a new session with one click.
strings.exit_behavior_hint: If it fails, the session stays open so you can read the error.
strings.secret_prompt_password_rejected: The server rejected the password. Try again.
strings.desc_equalize_panes: Give every pane the same size after a split
strings.desc_theme: The window and the terminal switch together
strings.desc_shell: Program started in every new terminal
strings.desc_default_editor: Opens files from the Files panel
strings.err_title_duplicate: A sibling with this title already exists.
strings.err_ssh_port_positive: SSH port must be greater than 0.
strings.tpl_working_directory_not_directory: Working directory is not a directory: {path}
strings.tpl_identity_file_not_file: Identity file is not a file: {path}
strings.tpl_secret_prompt_passphrase_hint: {launch} needs this key to connect as {account}.
strings.tpl_secret_prompt_password_hint: {launch} needs the password to connect as {account}.
strings.tpl_process_exited: Process exited with code {code}. Press any key to close.
